ghcnd_<N>: Daily weather observations: one row per station-date-element reading (columns: id [station id], date, element, value, mflag, qflag, sflag, time) — measures: value; keys: id, date, element.
ghcnd_states: US states reference: one row per state (columns: code, name, source_url, etl_timestamp) — entity: state; keys: code; measures: source_url, etl_timestamp.
ghcnd_stations: Station metadata: one row per weather station (columns: id, latitude, longitude, elevation, state, name, gsn_flag, hcn_crn_flag, wmoid, source_url, etl_timestamp) — entity: station; keys: id; measures/attributes: latitude, longitude, elevation, state, flags, wmoid.
ghcnd_countries: Country reference: one row per country (columns: code, name, source_url, etl_timestamp) — entity: country; keys: code; measures: source_url, etl_timestamp.
ghcnd_inventory: Station element inventory: one row per station-element (columns: id, latitude, longitude, element, firstyear, lastyear, source_url, etl_timestamp) — grain: station × element; keys: id, element; measures: firstyear, lastyear.
